GI Procedure Report
Date of service: 2026-10-21
Procedure: Colonoscopy.
Indication: Average-risk screening.
Technique: The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum. The appendiceal orifice and the ileocecal valve were
identified. Bowel preparation was good.
Findings: A 6 mm sessile polyp in the ascending colon was removed with a cold snare and retrieved for
pathology. A 3 mm polyp in the rectum was biopsied with cold forceps.
Impression: Two polyps; one removed by cold snare, one biopsied.
Plan: Await pathology. Repeat colonoscopy in 7 years.
